title: Curve units known to their quantity
description: A curve whose upper-cased mnemonic is in a quantity's suggest_from mnemonics (quantities.json) has a unit, as written, in that quantity's units. A curve fails once; its example row is the curve's 1-based position in ~Curve and its value the mnemonic.

words.template: {count} curves have a unit their quantity does not list.
